tools.name: pay
tools.description: Use when you must pay anything: an HTTP 402 / x402 invoice, a paywalled API URL, a payment link, a solana:/ethereum:/bitcoin: URI, or plain text like 'send 5 USDC to 0x... on base'. Pays the exact amount from any token you hold on 25+ chains. To swap or bridge, pay your own address on the other chai

tools.name: get_quote
tools.description: Use when you need a price before paying or swapping: any token to any token across 25+ chains (BTC, ETH, SOL, Base, Arbitrum, Tron, NEAR, TON, Sui, XRP...). No addresses, nothing committed.

tools.name: get_swap_status
tools.description: Use after funds are sent (or a wallet_link is shared) to track the payment. wait_seconds up to 25 waits on the server for a change. Done when final=true. Next: get_receipt.

tools.name: get_receipt
tools.description: Use when a payment is complete and you need proof: a signed receipt with amounts, chains, transaction hashes and the fee, to show your owner or the other party.

tools.name: create_payment_link
tools.description: Use when YOU want to get paid: creates a payment link that is also an invoice. The payer can use any coin on any chain; you receive exactly the token you choose. Next: share the link, then check_payment.

tools.name: check_payment
tools.description: Use to see whether an invoice from create_payment_link is paid: unpaid, processing or paid, with every attempt. Deliver only after it says paid.

tools.name: find_paywalls
tools.description: Use when you need a paid API or data source: searches APIs that sell calls to agents for any coin, with price and the seller's track record. Buy with buy_access.

tools.name: buy_access
tools.description: Use when a Swap Ripper /g/ URL answered 402, or you picked an API from find_paywalls: buys a pack of calls and returns an access_key (send it as header X-Access-Key) plus a way to pay in any coin.

tools.name: access_status
tools.description: Use to see how many paid calls an access_key has left. It activates packs automatically once they're paid.

tools.name: create_spending_policy
tools.description: Use when a human owner wants limits on an agent: max per payment, max per day, and optional approval above an amount. Returns a locked connection URL to give the agent.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "pay" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
